metadata.title: doc — self-hosted collaborative document infrastructure
metadata.description: A portable, self-hosted document plane for people and AI agents

home.subTitle: Write, collaborate, and preserve decisions on infrastructure you control. Rich text, realtime editing, version history, and AI assistance share one portable document core.
home.AIWritingDesc: Improve writing efficiency and quality with AI technology
home.AIChatDesc: Interact with AI chat, get inspiration, solve problems, and easily insert or copy to the editor
home.collabDesc: Real-time collaboration with others to complete projects together
home.AIGenTextDesc: Generate outlines, summaries, continuations, and rewrites from the current document, with a human review step.
home.AIProcessTextTitle: AI Text Optimization with Selected Text
home.AIProcessTextDesc: According the selection content, expand, simplify, switch tone, translate, explain, generate different styles with one click
home.shareAndCollabTitle: Share with multiple people, real-time collaboration
home.shareAndCollabDesc: One-click sharing, control permissions, multiple people editing, real-time collaboration, complete projects together
home.title2: One core for the complete document lifecycle
home.desc2: Creation, organization, search, collaboration, publishing, and recovery share the same data and permission model.
home.documentManagementDesc: Nested folders, drag sorting, favorites, search, trash, and public publishing.
home.richTextEditorDesc: Beautiful, intuitive editor with blocks, formatting, embeds, and everything you need to create stunning documents
home.desc3: Discover how our powerful features transform the way you work
home.versionHistoryDesc: Keep structured snapshots, compare revisions, and preserve the current state before a restore.
home.title4: UI, API, and collaboration on one document core
home.architectureDesc: Next.js serves the product and API, PostgreSQL stores permissions and document state, and Yjs/Hocuspocus provides realtime collaboration. Every surface operates on the same document facts.
home.uiSurface: Editing, organization, sharing, and review for people.
home.apiSurface: Contracts for auth, documents, versions, publishing, and AI.
home.collabSurface: Realtime editing, offline sync, and recoverable collaboration state.
home.inspirationDesc: Stuck on how to start? Let AI brainstorm some ideas for you
home.optimizationDesc: How to write better and more professionally? Let AI help you optimize and polish your text
home.askQuestionDesc: Encountering problems? Use AI chat to query and find answers
home.desc5: doc is designed for self-hosting. The model, storage, collaboration service, and authentication boundary stay under the deployer's control.
